movelist.name: Heal Block
movelist.effect: Until the end of the encounter, the target may not gain Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points from any source. This effect ends if the target is switched out or Takes a Breather.

movelist.name: Flash Cannon
movelist.effect: Flash Cannon lowers the target’s Special Defense by 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Roar of Time
movelist.effect: All legal targets are Slowed, even if the attack misses.

movelist.name: Iron Tail
movelist.effect: Iron Tail lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 15+.

movelist.name: Earth Power
movelist.effect: Earth Power lowers the Special Defense of all Legal Targets 1 Combat Stage on 16+.

abilities.name: Probability Control
abilities.effect: The user may reroll any roll, or have any ally reroll any roll that has been made. This leaves discoverable Psychic residue.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.trigger: The user is Paralyzed, Frozen, Burned,
abilities.effect: The foe which caused the Status Condition is given the same Status they inflicted.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.effect: The user’s Weight Class is increased by +2. Their Defense Base Stat is increased by +2, but their Speed Base Stat is decreased by 2.
